neighbours.label: the first word-piece of a title or proper name that opens with a rare, multi-token word (The Berenstain Bears, The Perks of..., Montessori), as against ordinary nouns and single-token place names in the same position
fire: For her birthday my sister got a hardback copy of The Hobbit with maps inside.
Every night the twins ask their father to read The Lorax one more time.
Our class spent the whole term reading The Silmarillion out loud.
The toddler cannot fall asleep without hearing The Gruffalo first.
My grandmother kept a worn paperback of The Catcher in the Rye by her bed.
In the spring we studied The Grapes of Wrath in English class.
On the shelf next to the window sat The Velveteen Rabbit and two atlases.
Last night I started reading The Phantom Tollbooth to my son.
quiet: For her birthday my sister got a hardback copy of the atlas with maps inside.
Every night the twins ask their father to read the story one more time.
Our class spent the whole term reading the newspaper out loud.
The toddler cannot fall asleep without hearing the song first.
My grandmother kept a worn paperback of poems by her bed.
In the spring we studied the history of Texas in English class.
On the shelf next to the window sat the old radio and two atlases.
Last night I started reading a story about pirates to my son.
